name: Municipio de Quito
body: Structured data naming the municipality, full share cards, alt text on every image, nosniff, and Secure cookies. But a made-up path answers 200 with the home page title, so search engines see a soft 404.
lesson: Return a real 404 status for unknown URLs, with a helpful page and a search box.
summary: www.quito.gob.ec scores 77 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 20 pages have no meta description.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /?page_id=662, /?page_id=4451, /?page_id=122 and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 18 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

fix.title: The start page took 1827 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 6.2 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 153 ms (good), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.17 (needs improvement). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
Every image has an alt attribute
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
